method: Parsed complete name/description catalogs; compared objective, input, decision method and output.

nearestExisting.name: Splitvalue Desk
nearestExisting.desc: Turn joint-production handoffs into reviewed NRV cost worksheets with real local MiniLM cost-role inference. nearestExisting.name: Unitloom Desk
nearestExisting.desc: Turn rough production-cost notes into equivalent-unit worksheets with real local MiniLM cost-pattern inference. Review start, uniform or completion-only treatment, conserve exact minor units, compare physical-count allocations and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or ledger writes.

nearestExisting.name: Cost Tapestry
nearestExisting.desc: Reconcile resource-use notes with real local MiniLM activity-pool inference. Review drivers, allocate overhead in exact cents, compare product unit costs against volume allocation and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or ledger changes.

difference: Reciprocal simultaneous support-cost equations with mutual services and cent-conserving final burdens, rather than activity-driver overhead or joint/equivalent-unit production allocation.
